settings.settings_source: states: E242's settings e62 (experiments/kstar_vpd_wording_a/results/predictions.json), the six E62 states at own size as E257's World builds them (not the scaled lookups). D: E257's D of each item (512 windows of E187's read half of the e62 group: copy windows, windows without the cue and far text, 3:3:2); the copy windows are those with the marker last and A once before 'A M' (experiments/head_edit/run.py targets: 206 of 512 on e62/copy_s0's D, E280 CPU dry run). K: E275's saved in_K (experiments/claim2_needed/results/large/items_e62-<state>.npz), unchanged. cache_batch: E268's (kstar_needed load_config). control: the state whose all-D pass stage 0 repeats. repeat_tol: an absolute tolerance on E_b, E257's measured floor (experiments/rb_states/results/stage0_*.json floor, |E_b bf16 - E_b fp32| on x2 through the same write_change path; E268 filed it as kept_floor): a fp32 rerun on another card differs from E257's saved arrays by accumulation order only, which is below bf16 rounding; E268's transcription_rel_tol (1e-11) bounds a sum over saved arrays, not a recomputed pass, so it does not apply. Stage 0 also records a second pass on the same card (its difference from the first, the same-card floor) beside it. too_small: the card's floor. rival_gap: the card's smallest_gap

readings.E_b_K_copy: commute.stand_in.explained_share(num, den, dd, K and changed) with num, den, dd from one stand_in.write_change pass on the copy windows of D only
readings.E_b_changed_copy: the same over every changed variable
readings.E_b_K_all: the same from the all-D pass (beside E275's saved E_b_K)
readings.copy_dd_share_K: sum over K and changed of dd on the copy windows / the same on all of D (dd sums over windows, so the copy windows' share of K's write change)

rules.R0a: Stage 0 stops the job unless the do-nothing (F = M, E257's) has no changed variable, every dd exactly 0.0 and E_b over K exactly 1.0
rules.R0b: Stage 0 stops the job unless the control's all-D write pass repeats E275's saved E_b over K and E257's saved E_b over K* each within repeat_tol (absolute), with the saved arrays' length and changed set equal to this featurization's; dd's relative L1 difference from E257's saved dd is recorded

expected.stage0: do-nothing: 0 changed, dd max 0.0, E_b 1.0; control: E_b over K 0.03761000378175188 (E275) and over K* 0.039088031212285636 (E257) within repeat_tol; time a few minutes on an L40 (model load dominates; each pass is one 512-window forward)
expected.copy_windows: rival A: mean over seeds 0-2 of E_b_K_copy, copy minus lookup, at least rival_gap; rival B: under rival_gap. |K| as E275's (9,271 to 30,688), none under too_small
